description: This PHP source file defines the SocialMediaAuthenticationService class, which manages social media-based authentication processes within the OrangeHRM system, including initiating OpenID Connect authentication, user retrieval, and identity management.

classes.name: SocialMediaAuthenticationService
classes.description: Service class managing social media authentication, including initiating OpenID Connect flows, user retrieval, and identity management within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getAuthProviderDao
methods.description: Returns the AuthProviderDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getUserDao
methods.description: Returns the UserDao instance, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: initiateAuthentication
methods.description: Creates and configures an OpenIDConnectClient for social media authentication using provider details.

methods.name: getRedirectURL
methods.description: Generates the redirect URL for OIDC login.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope string used for authentication.

methods.name: getSystemUsers
methods.description: Retrieves system users matching the provided credentials.

methods.name: getUserForAuthenticate
methods.description: Authenticates and retrieves a user based on credentials, with validation checks.

methods.name: setOIDCUserIdentity
methods.description: Associates a user with an OpenID provider identity.

methods.name: isSocialMediaAuthEnable
methods.description: Checks if social media authentication providers are enabled.
